# third_party/scip — vendored SCIP protobuf types

`fathom export scip` (VB-32, `internal/analysis/scipexport`) needs the
[SCIP](https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip) wire-format message types
(`Index`, `Document`, `SymbolInformation`, `Occurrence`, `Relationship`, …)
to build and marshal an index. Depending on the upstream module directly
(`github.com/sourcegraph/scip`) pulled in a `//go:build tools` dev-dependency
file (`bindings/go/scip/tools.go`) that blank-imports `github.com/bufbuild/
buf/cmd/buf` — `go mod tidy` resolves module requirements for **every** build
tag combination, tools included, so that one file dragged in `buf`'s own
pin of `github.com/tetratelabs/wazero/experimental/gojs`, a package absent
from this repo's pinned wazero — a real, unrelated version conflict, not
something a `replace` or exclude could fix cleanly. Vendoring only the
generated file this repo actually uses removes the dependency (and every
transitive package that came with it) entirely.

## What is vendored, from where

| File | Upstream path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `scip.pb.go` | `bindings/go/scip/scip.pb.go` | Machine-generated by `protoc-gen-go`; **verbatim**, `package scip` unchanged. Self-contained: its only imports are `reflect`, `sync`, and `google.golang.org/protobuf/{reflect/protoreflect,runtime/protoimpl}` — already a fathom dependency, and the only one this vendor needs. |
| `scip.proto` | `scip.proto` | The `.proto` source `scip.pb.go` was generated from — kept alongside for provenance/re-generation, not compiled by fathom. |
| `LICENSE` | `LICENSE` | Upstream's Apache-2.0 license, verbatim, as required to redistribute the code above. |

**Not vendored:** `bindings/go/scip/symbol.go` / `symbol_parser.go` (the
hand-written `ParseSymbol` and `SymbolFormatter` machinery) — `scipexport`
does not need them. Symbol-ID *rendering* is a small, fixed-shape subset of
SCIP's grammar (`internal/analysis/scipexport.formatSymbolID`, hand-written
against the spec directly, matching the real `VerboseSymbolFormatter`'s
empirically-observed output for our exact structure — see that function's
doc comment); the untested `scip-go` round-trip comparison path uses a
best-effort bare-name heuristic (`bareSymbolName`) rather than a full
parser, since it only ever needs to compare against *scip-go's own* symbol
strings, not re-derive fathom's.

## Provenance

- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip`
- Upstream module path (at the vendored version): `github.com/sourcegraph/scip`
  — renamed to `github.com/scip-code/scip` starting at tag `v0.7.0`; the
  vendored files predate that rename and are unaffected by it.
- Vendored tag: **`v0.6.1`**
- Vendored commit: **`9d5796159c97c3b107355c424f6c06fb1a0ea01c`**
  (`git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip.git v0.6.1`)
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

## Keeping this in sync

These files are the wire format's message shapes, not a library API fathom
calls into in any deeper way — they change only when the SCIP spec itself
adds a field, which is rare and always additive (protobuf's own compat
rules). There is no `sync-*` script and no `vendor-check.sh` entry for this
directory (unlike `third_party/agentic-kit` / `third_party/app-kit`,
`docs/distribution.md`'s ADR-019 pattern): those two are continuously
co-developed private modules synced from a sibling checkout via a content
hash check, which requires a live sibling repo to compare against. `scip` is
a third-party OSS dependency vendored as a point-in-time, hand-copied
snapshot instead — re-running the two commands below against a newer tag
and re-copying the one generated file is the entire "sync" procedure:

```sh
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip.git <new-tag>
GOFLAGS= GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org go mod download github.com/sourcegraph/scip@<new-tag>   # to a scratch GOPATH, not this repo's go.mod
cp <module cache>/bindings/go/scip/scip.pb.go  third_party/scip/scip.pb.go
cp <module cache>/scip.proto                    third_party/scip/scip.proto
cp <module cache>/LICENSE                       third_party/scip/LICENSE
```
